description: Test a third 20-union difference band in the shared QKV transform
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,695 parameters at 99.030000%, a +0.030000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 30 prior macro-attempts and 417 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0087/micro-0009 at 1,695 parameters and 99.03%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0087/micro-0010, whose next FF-output union scored 98.99% at 1,694 parameters. Shared QKV has retained 40 ordered unions without a scored failure. Hypothesis: attention-transform redundancy extends beyond both measured feed-forward boundaries, so the next ascending-difference QKV band can still reduce parameters while preserving qualification. This parameterization-preserving compression is more informative than excluding either failed FF pair because it returns to the only large tensor site whose ordered path remains open and tests a new difference range. Each micro-trial adds one QKV union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at 20 micro-trials, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 30 wall-clock minutes.
summary: No candidate was scored. The first intended QKV union hit a reproducible implementation error during model construction because the QKV helper's source insertion boundary had become stale after adding FF scalar-pair constants and inserted QKV coordinates into the 256-entry FF-output list, causing an IndexError. This is not capacity evidence. Frontier remained 1,695 parameters at 99.03%; 0 accepts, 0 scored discards, 1 implementation error, negligible compute. Stop reason: recorded implementation error before the 20-trial/30-minute cap.
